# Quillwood Garden Supplies — May 2026 sales lines export

One row per order line as captured by the till integration; rows are in
capture order, not date order. Columns:

    line_id, order_id, order_date, sku, title, warehouse, qty,
    unit_price_gbp, line_total_gbp

A given SKU appears at most once on an order, so distinct order_id values
per SKU are the number of orders the SKU sold into.

The 4 May export run hit a gateway timeout and rewrote a stretch of the
file: a few lines appear twice, byte-identical, under the same line_id.
Line counts are therefore not order counts.
